notes.title: Update: Korean Language Support
notes.notes:
Hello.
We have released an update to "Enjoy the Diner" on April 11, 2024.
By applying this update, we have added new Korean language support.
You can switch languages from the options.
There are no other bug fixes.

We hope you will continue to enjoy this game.
Thanks!

notes.title: Update on November 21, 2023
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing Enjoy the Diner.

An update was released on November 21, 2023. By applying this update,
The following features will be added.

Piano mode has been added.
A piano solo mode has been added to the BGM, a major feature of this title.
The BGM can be switched between normal BGM and piano BGM by pressing the keyboard icon on the settings screen.

Added text display mode
In addition to the normal text window and window + subtitle,
In addition to the normal text window and window + subtitle, we have added a mode that displays only subtitles.
This mode is recommended for those who want to immerse themselves in the world without text on the game screen.

Thanks!

notes.title: Update on August 10, 2023 (bug fixes)
notes.notes:
Hi there,

Thank you for playing "Enjoy the Diner".
An update was released on August 10, 2023.
This update fixes the following bugs.

 1. fixed a bug that the game did not start if the OS was in a certain language.
As an example, we fixed a problem in which the game would not start if the language setting on the Windows side was French. This was due to the decimal point being written differently in some languages than in Japan or the United States. 

2. fixed a bug in which the conditions for obtaining some Steam achievements were incorrect
For a few hours at the time of release, there was a bug that when you acquired the "Possible" achievement, you could also acquire the "Accidental? was also obtained at the same time. This has been completely fixed in this update.

Please continue to enjoy "Enjoy the Diner" :)

Thanks!

notes.title: Update on August 1, 2023 (bug fixes)
notes.notes:
Hi there,

We are sorry for the quick update right after the launch day.
For those playing in Chinese (Simplified/Traditional), there was a bug that prevented progress in some routes. If you are playing in other languages, there is no problem, and save data in all languages is unaffected. 

We hope you continue to enjoy your stay in the Moon palace.

Thanks!
